content:
Statement

A suitable variable name for a string would be [[s]].

Goal

Instead of "Given a number", write "Given a string [[s]] containing a number"*. Instead of "its current base, and a target base", write "its current base, [[B1]], and a target base, [[B2]]".

For clarity:
Instead of "The input number will always be valid in its original base", write "The input number from the string [[s]] will always be valid in its original base, [[B1]]".
Format constant values as {{constants}}.

Input

You can finish the line 1 input with "to the target base, which is [[B2]]".
Instead of " the current base of [[N]]", write "the current base of the number from the string [[s]]".

Output

Instead of "A string representing the number [[N]] converted into base [[B2]]", write "The number from the string [[s]] converted into the target base, [[B2]]".

Constraints

Format constant values as {{constants}}.
*******
*Notes*
*******
Alternatively, instead of having to write "the number from the string [[s]]", you could directly prompt the coder to parse the string [[s]] to a variable [[N]] by writing instead: "Given a string [[s]] containing a number [[N]]".

Thank you for taking your time to read this
